title: agent-convergence-scorer: behavioral convergence scoring for non-deterministic LLM agents
description: agent-convergence-scorer is a behavioral evaluation tool that scores how similar N agent outputs are - exact-match rate, Jaccard token overlap, divergence point, and a composite 0-1 convergence score over any fan-out of agent runs. It judges agents by what they actually produce across repeated trials rather than by their configuration, turning run-to-run divergence into a single number you can gate CI on. Stdlib-only, zero runtime dependencies.
